title: Language policy: everything written is English, only the report to the owner uses the workspace report language, and every session is told so
goal: Verified failure (2026-11-13): a run lead wrote a harness plan-mode plan file in Vietnamese. The english-only rule named only code, comments, docs, changelogs and commit messages, the snapshot printed only the rule id, and nothing checked what agents write. Make the policy explicit, visible in every snapshot and dispatched spec, and advised by the hooks.

tasks.grade_reason: registry rule text, one snapshot line, two advisory guards reusing an existing heuristic, spec line, tests; follows existing guard and test patterns
tasks.objective: Make the language policy explicit and enforced by advisories. (1) Registry: in registry/core.json add workspace.report_language with the value Vietnamese, and rewrite global_rules english-only so it says: everything written is English - code, comments, docs, changelogs, commit messages, PR and issue text, plan files (including the harness plan-mode plan file), briefs and specs for agents, inter-agent messages, artifacts and memory files; only the report addressed to the owner (chat replies, status updates, questions, the final report) is written in workspace.report_language. Update docs/registry.schema.json for the new key and rebuild registry.json with scripts/build-registry.py. For workspaces without a registry add the matching optional setting to skills/delivery/pipeline-defaults.json (no report language set means the user's own language). (2) Snapshot: scripts/lib/snapshot_render.py prints, in every snapshot and not only with --full, one line right after the Rules line: Language: write everything in English (files, plans, briefs, messages, commits, PR text); report to the owner in <report_language>. (3) Dispatched specs: scripts/factory-pipeline.py adds one Language line with the same two halves to every spec kind it prints (planner, lead, implement, verify, review, qa); the line says that reports between sessions are English and only the run lead's report to the owner uses the report language. (4) Hooks, advisory only (never a permissionDecision, never a crash, guard errors mean no opinion, stay fast, no repository scan): move the detection of scripts/checks/english-only.py (letters from non-Latin scripts; lines where 5 percent or more of the letters are non-ASCII Latin) into a shared module under scripts/lib/ that the check, scripts/file-guard.py and the git guard import. scripts/file-guard.py emits rpg-factory advisory (warn) naming rule english-only and the first offending line when the text a Write, Edit, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit call would write trips the detection and the target is inside a registered repo, the plugin, a docs/plans/ directory, or a harness plan or memory directory (a path segment .claude/plans or .claude/projects/<x>/memory); paths matching a new registry list workspace.language_allow (globs for localisation data such as **/Localization/**, **/Locales/**, **/i18n/**, **/*.po) and the english-only allowlist are skipped; a Read never triggers it. The git guard (scripts/git-guard.py with scripts/lib/gitguard.py) emits the same warn advisory for the message text of git commit -m/--message, gh pr create|edit --title/--body, gh issue create|comment --title/--body, orca orchestration send --subject/--body and orca agent launch --prompt. If the Agent tool prompt can be checked by adding its matcher to hooks/hooks.json (and the Codex equivalent in hooks/codex-hooks.json) with the existing guard process, do so; otherwise name it as a limitation in the report. (5) Prose: state the policy once in skills/factory-core/references/report.md (the report to the owner is in the report language; everything else English) and in skills/delivery/references/delivery.md section 3 (a spec and every session report are English; the run lead's report to the user follows the project's report language), keep the single-copy and line-budget rules of tests/skills-lint.sh and tests/parallel-policy.test.sh; update the English only bullet of .claude/CLAUDE.md and add one Operating lesson naming this failure and its reason. (6) Tests: extend tests/english-only.test.sh for the shared module; cases in tests/file-guard.test.sh (Vietnamese payload into a repo file, a plan file and a memory file gives the advisory; English payload, a Read, and an allowlisted localisation path give none) and tests/git-guard.test.sh (each command form above, plus an English control); a snapshot assertion that the Language line is present without --full; a tests/pipeline.test.sh case that each spec kind carries the Language line; update golden fixtures the change moves. (7) One fragment changelog.d/language-policy.md (### Changed and ### Added). Hook speed budget (tests/hook-perf.test.sh) must still hold.
acceptance: every snapshot prints the Language line with the registry report language, without --full
every dispatched spec kind carries the Language line
a Write or Edit of Vietnamese text into a repo file, a plan file or a memory file produces a warn advisory naming english-only; English text, a Read and an allowlisted localisation path produce none
git commit -m, gh pr and gh issue text, orca send and orca agent launch prompts with Vietnamese text produce the same advisory; English text produces none
no hook blocks, asks or crashes; the hook speed budget holds
registry.json is the build of the fragments and check-registry passes
